parsed.brief_reason: The patch removes the recursive call to tryMinimizeExits on finally blocks, which causes the code to fail to preserve exit statements (break/return) that should remain in finally blocks. The failing tests show that break and return statements are being incorrectly removed from finally blocks, indicating the patch deletes necessary functionality rather than fixing the underlying bug.

The patch removes recursive processing of finally blocks in try-catch-finally statements, which was incorrectly removing exit statements (break, return) from finally blocks. The comment explicitly warns against this optimization due to ECMA 262 semantics where finally blocks can change completion type. The patch correctly preserves finally block behavior while passing all tests.
